sources: `${route} loads clean`
'epic canvas has a size and nodes'
`an edge-less epic is one card per node, with no canvas, at ${at}`
`the go-live first frame reads (zoom >= 0.6) and Fit all shows everything at ${at}`
`the "No dependencies" strip clears the rail on ${route} at ${at}`
`no card status word is cut mid-word on ${route} at ${at}`
'a node click opens the popover and writes ?node='
`the done toggle is disabled and says why when nothing can fold at ${at}`
`"Done · collapsed" folds host-contract to "8 done" and keeps it on screen at ${at}`
`a ?node= link into a folded chain opens it and walks with ← and → at ${at}`
`the lineage arrows walk one edge at a time and stop at the ends at ${at}`
`+#2397 dims every node not upstream of #2397, and a reload restores it at ${at}`
`L fills +#N+ and the arrows walk within the selection at ${at}`
`the epic rail folds without overlapping at ${width}x${height}`
'a short window keeps the canvas and folds the rail away'
'the wheel over the canvas zooms the viewport'
'a Work row click opens that item'
`the first-run card shows the failing check at ${size.width}px`
`the first-run card teaches kew init with no config at ${size.width}px`
'selecting a Work item with no runs is quiet and says "No run yet"'
'a Monitor preset click changes the range'
'the Work pipeline does not overlap itself at 390px'
'the top nav keeps Work, Monitor and Epics whole at 390px'
'the header does not overflow or overlap itself in any failure state'
'the epic tick strip keeps its newest end inside its box'
`the launchpad keeps its fix links in their own box at ${width}px`
`the palette opens, fits and returns focus on Esc at ${width}px`
'an ask over the daily budget shows the refusal and Enter does nothing'
`the dispatch plan is one line closed and a drawer open at ${width}px`
`the ? overlay lists Work's keys and Esc returns the focus at ${width}px`
`commands read in text-1 and the focus ring is cyan at ${width}px`
`no legend on ${EPIC} prints a 0 count`
'the Epics Signal cell is not ellipsised for progressing at 1440px'
`the ${GO_LIVE} legend and the header count one set at ${width}px`
`#${SENTENCE_ITEM} says one sentence on /work, /monitor and the epic popover at ${width}px`
`every row the header counts wears the diamond and leads /work at ${width}px`
`the header counts no slot wait or serve-only credential as down at ${width}px`
`/work draws its header and "Reading work items…" while the work read is held, at ${width}px`
`/work's .keys legend and needs-you strip follow the 1024 fold at ${width}px`
'the Monitor spend figures sit on one line at 390px'
'an Epics row with ticks never reads "no ticks yet"'
